lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a grid-like intersection pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small, slender teleost fish are visible trailing the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
